integrity: All reported finite numerical and exact-rational checks were run using the included checker.py; the theorem for unbounded sizes and all positive real parameters follows from the written proof, not from finite computations. No independent audit or independent validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The principal new claim treats unequal positive clique sizes m,n>=2 and a single irreversible sink with strictly positive hopping and loss rates. It is an infinite-time, noiseless one-excitation result; arbitrary initial superpositions, multiple sinks, dephasing and finite capture times are outside scope. The isotropic square rook case follows from the existing strongly regular graph result of Razzoli et al. (2021) and is cited as prior work, not as a novel finding. Historical priority of the explicit anisotropic rectangular formulas is not independently certified.
title: A unique anisotropic trapping resonance on rectangular rook quantum networks
